gen-dafont-azonix-gf-lexend-giga: Wide, stern and a bit techy, Azonix hits hard up top. Lexend Giga follows with flat, single-weight lines and generously spaced words, which makes the strongest quality here the crisp command of the heading.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-lexend-mega: Wide-mouthed and stern, Azonix grabs the eye with capitals barely taller than its lowercase. Lexend Mega is the friendlier one, drawn as if with a single nib, while the heading does the commanding.
gen-dafont-bebas-kai-fs-erode: Compact, tidy and high-waisted, Bebas Kai packs its letters tight. Erode, a text serif, takes the quieter job, with a gentle ebb and flow of weight that never drops to razor-fine hairlines.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-lexend-giga: Blockletter has a tall midsection, like a squat brush-pen belly, drawn as if by a pencil that never presses harder. Lexend Giga then spaces its flat sans-serif words generously, so extended reading goes down smoothly.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-cascadia-mono: Big round lowercase bowls give Bloody a heavy, commanding look. Cascadia Mono, a plain sans, stands nearby like pins in a wide board, quiet where the heading shouts.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-julius-sans-one: Bloody makes big, round lowercase bowls that look commanding and a little menacing against the page. Julius Sans One glides under the eye like wire, with plenty of blank space between letters.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-lexend-giga: Bloody leads with big round lowercase bowls and a commanding, slightly menacing swagger. Lexend Giga is flat, single-weight sans-serif with spacious words, so reading moves along smoothly.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-lexend-mega: Lexend Mega reads friendly and modern, with a body height nearly matching its capitals. Bloody's big round bowls add a commanding contrast above, while the sans-serif body stays drawn with one nib.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-lexend-tera: Bloody throws down big round lowercase bowls, commanding and a bit sinister. Lexend Tera, a plain sans, spaces its single-weight letters like stepping stones, so a long read moves along easily.
